caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass tumbler placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The glass has a slightly conical shape, with a wider opening at the top and narrowing towards the base. There is a thickened rim around the top edge of the glass, and the material appears clear with a faint bluish tint, characteristic of glass. Subtle shading and highlights are used to indicate the reflective quality of the glass, with light areas on the top rim and side surfaces, and some gentle shadows inside and beneath the base. The background is unadorned and uniform, with no other objects present, and there is a faint hint of texture and discoloration on the paper, mainly in the lower part. A small, handwritten signature is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Jelly Tumbler
